note: type=hold => app plays the entry once and freezes on the final (held) frame for the full countdown; no reverse exit (the UI moves to the Rest screen). type=rep => seamless loop; author one-way 'ping-pong' reps (gobletSquat, walkingLunge, vUp) as a baked forward+reverse boomerang so they loop cleanly.

squat.note: grid method replacement (side profile). Fixed head-crop from the old text-to-video clip.

frontSquat.note: trainer re-check: confirm bar is racked on FRONT delts, not the back. Regenerate via grid if wrong.

kneePushUp.note: trainer re-check: confirm knees stay down (beginner regression), not a full push-up. Regenerate via grid if wrong.

candlestick.note: one-way entry into inverted candlestick/shoulder-stand; trainer to confirm name

hollowHold.note: grid method (final). Clean grounded hollow entry+hold, green core.

plank.note: grid method. Clean forearm-plank entry+hold, green core preserved.

vUp.note: grid method. Fold to a balanced V; app ping-pongs A->B for the full rep.

kneePlank.note: grid method. Knees-down plank, green core.

gobletSquat.note: grid method. Standing->bottom of squat, kettlebell at chest; app ping-pongs for the rep.

walkingLunge.note: grid method. Standing->forward lunge 90/90; app ping-pongs for the rep.

lSit.note: grid method (batch 2). Seated->L-sit supported on hands; core + quads green.

backSquat.note: grid method (batch 2). Bar on traps, below parallel; app ping-pongs.

overheadSquat.note: grid method (batch 2). Bar locked overhead through full depth; app ping-pongs.

benchPress.note: grid method (batch 2). Chest->lockout on a flat bench; app ping-pongs.

pushPress.note: grid method (batch 2). Rack + dip -> overhead lockout; app ping-pongs.

chestToBar.note: grid method (batch 2). 3/4-front, scale-locked so the body rises to a fixed bar; app ping-pongs.
